ns2:section.sectionText: ALL ACCY 201 SECTIONS RESTRICTED TO COLLEGE OF BUSINESS, ACE, ACES, CS MAJORS. ALL OTHERS MAY ENROLL ON AUGUST 3 IF SPACE IS AVAILABLE.
